description: What is actually happening on-chain with a token's locked allocations: the vesting contracts and wallets holding team, investor and treasury tokens, how much they hold now, outflows (tokens leaving locked wallets), mints, burns and contract upgrades, the next unlock by the project's own documents, and our short finding (for example: unlocked but never withdrawn, tranches sent to an exchange, vesting contract has not paid out). Use for 'are team tokens moving', 'did the unlock really happen', 'who is selling'. Without a token: recent movements across all covered tokens. token accepts a ticker (preferred), a name or a slug; covered_tokens in the result lists what we track (a few dozen tokens, not the whole calendar). Movements look back at most 30 days; wallet roles marked 'our attribution' are our analysis, not the project's statement. For the unlock calendar use get_token_unlocks.

days.description: Look-back window for the list of recent movements (no token).

token.description: Ticker, name or slug. Leave empty for recent movements across all covered tokens.
